name: Sun Tzu
source:
"If you know your enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the results of a hundred battles. This is a famous saying of mine. Remember it, because it will be on the test."

Based on Sun Zu, who was a Chinese military general, strategist, and philosopher who lived in the Spring and Autumn period of ancient China.

A military genius supporting the Taika Empire along with [url=/c5212]Lu Bu[/url]. Although she displays much self-confidence as she takes measures, any unanticipated factors easily upset her. In a nutshell, she fails to show her real ability when she needs to.

She and Lu Bu, a close friend of hers, have together been searching everywhere for a medicine capable of improving [url=/c5206]Qin Shi Huang's[/url] fragile health. She loves teaching people.
